display.purpose: Onboarding slide titles — one large cream instruction on the hood.

title.purpose: Sidebar wordmark, section titles, header title.

body.purpose: Default UI copy. Supporting slide text at 13px on secondary.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked status and field names: KEY, WHISPER, ON AIR.

prompter.purpose: Live ready-to-speak answers. The session’s only large type.

mono.purpose: Keycaps, response counters, live elapsed time.

shadows.name: tally-lamp

shadows.name: tally-unlit-inset

shadows.name: focus-ring

narrative.overview:
Menace Agent is a newsroom teleprompter in a Mac window: a matte black hood, cream-white copy, and a single red camera tally. Setup is a centered board of hairline plates (KEY, WHISPER, permissions). Once the session starts, the app collapses into a compact always-on-top strip whose job is ready-to-speak lines — not a copilot dashboard.

The material is opaque metal and matte plastic, not glass. Edges are cream at 8–14% opacity — a bezel that catches light, not a drawn box. Type is the Mac’s own sans, set like a prompter: one large instruction on the hood, then 20px medium lines you can read aloud while the call stays in front. Personality stays dry and on-air, not corporate and not neon-AI.
keyCharacteristics: Matte hood black with cream type and a scarce red tally
Hairline cream bezels; no glass, blur, or gradient-mesh chrome
System sans as the only display/body face; mono only for keys and counters
Window rounded as a hood (12px); plates stay tight (4px)
Depth from tonal steps and the tally lamp, not drop shadows or hard outlines

rules.name: The Tally Rule
rules.body: Red is the lamp and the go button. It does not fill sidebars, cards, or large fields. If a screen has more than one solid red rectangle, the lamp has been overused.

rules.name: The Four-Ink Rule
rules.body: Hood, cream, hairline, tally. Do not add a fifth brand hue. Success and warning stay in status notes.

rules.name: The Prompter Face Rule
rules.body: One system sans for everything a candidate reads. Do not introduce a display serif, a geometric AI sans, or a second UI family. Mono is for machine text only.

rules.name: The Ready-to-Speak Rule
rules.body: Live answers are 20px medium cream on hood. Do not drop session copy to body size to “fit more dashboard.”

rules.name: The Hairline Bezel Rule
rules.body: Opaque fill + cream-at-8% 1px edge. No solid gray chrome, no backdrop-filter, no frosted fill, no multi-stop brand gradients. If it looks like a drawn box or like glass, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Lamp-Only Glow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow exists for the tally dot. Not for buttons, plates, or nav.

dos: Do set cream type on hood black, and keep the red lamp scarce.
Do edge plates with cream-at-8% hairlines and 4px corners; depth comes from fill steps.
Do use one system-sans stack; set live answers at 20px medium.
Do mark session state with a circular tally + uppercase tracked label (ON AIR, KEY, WHISPER).
Do keep Start / Continue cream-on-tally in every hover and theme state.
donts: Don't build a neon glass AI-copilot: no frosted panels, aurora fills, indigo/violet meshes, or glow under cards.
Don't introduce a display serif, geometric “AI” sans, or a second UI family.
Don't fill large regions with tally red, or use a second accent as brand.
Don't drop-shadow plates or rest buttons on ambient shadows.
Don't paint a white or light hover on a cream-labeled go button.
Don't treat the live overlay like a dashboard; it is a prompter strip.
